summary: Verified and committed the Phase C attribution pass. Checked cnb/beams.ly, cnb/stems.ly, cnb/ledgers.ly in context: no 'ADAPTED FROM' phrasing or overstated relationships remained, so only articulations.ly needed (and already had) the 'RELATED PRIOR ART (no shared code)' reword — the three siblings were left unchanged. Deliverable commit a672a3e (README.md, cnb/articulations.ly, LICENSE).
